purpose: Ranking model configuration scaffold for post-JO recalibration and next-season tournament updates.

juniorOlympics.notes: Strongest late-season signal. Should heavily influence post-JO rankings but not erase full-season evidence.

futuresSuperFinals.notes: Major pre-JO event. Primary anchor for boys and peer major event for girls.

usClubChampionships.notes: Peer major event to Futures for girls groups. Use common-opponent crossover when fields differ.

majorInvitational.notes: KAP7, Turbo, Holiday Cup, SD County Cup, Newport Spring Invite, Year of the Horse, and similar events.

earlySeason.notes: Useful baseline but should decay as newer evidence becomes available.

D1.notes: D1 teams anchor upper ranking bands unless consistently bottom-tier.

D2.notes: Top D2 teams may pass bottom D1 teams only with strong supporting evidence.

D3.notes: Top D3 teams may pass lower D2 teams only with strong evidence.

primary.guardrail: Rank normally once club-specific aliases are reviewed.

secondary.guardrail: Can pass weaker A teams with evidence. Flag if top 25.

tertiary.guardrail: Can pass weaker B teams with evidence. Flag if top 50.

manualReviewFlags: strong pre-JO team with poor JO finish
weak pre-JO team with strong JO finish
